findings.title: Renamed and moved helpers may break existing imports and mock targets
findings.body: The PR removes `mark_failed_threshold`, `create_issue_platform_occurrence`, `get_failure_reason`, `get_monitor_environment_context`, `SimpleCheckIn` and the status maps from `mark_failed.py`, and renames two of them (`mark_failed_threshold` to `try_incident_threshold`, `create_issue_platform_occurrence` to `create_incident_occurrence`). Any other module or test that imports these names from `sentry.monitors.logic.mark_failed`, or patches them with a string target such as `sentry.monitors.logic.mark_failed.create_issue_platform_occurrence`, will now fail with ImportError or silently stop being patched. The diff touches only four files and includes no test updates or compatibility re-exports, so the repository state after this change is unverified for those references.

findings.title: Docstring typo in get_failure_reason
findings.body: The docstring reads "Builds a humam readible string". The text was carried over from the old module, and the PR is a move that already touches this code, so it is a cheap fix to make while the code is being relocated.
